SELECT 'sales' t, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d_rl, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, sum(net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns of those sales', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT (sales_line_id, return_date, quantity_returned, refund_net)), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), sum(refund_net)
FROM fact_return_line WHERE sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22')

WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, s.format, s.store_id, p.category
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qty_ret FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.store_id <> 999 AND l.category <> 'ZZ Test' THEN l.net_amount END) AS sold_net,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.store_id <> 999 AND l.category <> 'ZZ Test' THEN r.refund_net END) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.store_id <> 999 AND l.category <> 'ZZ Test' THEN r.refund_net END) / SUM(CASE WHEN l.store_id <> 999 AND l.category <> 'ZZ Test' THEN l.net_amount END), 3) AS rate_pct,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.store_id = 999 OR l.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN l.net_amount END) AS excluded_sold,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.qty_ret > l.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_returned,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.net_amount <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_lines
FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
